# SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3

Used only by the admin Excel price importer, loaded on demand.

Official source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js

Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/

License: Apache-2.0, included in `LICENSE`.

SHA-256 of `xlsx.full.min.js`:
`cc015130aa8521e7f088f88898eba949ccdcbfb38df0bd129b44b7273c3a6f41`

Spreadsheet parsing happens in the browser. The importer does not execute formulas or upload the original workbook.
